fields.scope: Staircase granite, floor tile, skirting and molding quantities as approved in signed measurements.
fields.measurement_and_rates: Measure each approved item by agreed units; enter gross quantity, deductions, net quantity and rate in a separate signed measurement sheet.
fields.schedule: Commencement date, sequencing and completion date require written agreement.
fields.payment_terms: Pay on checked work quantities and accepted invoices according to agreed milestones.
fields.quality_terms: Jointly inspect levels, finish, slope, grout, materials and site acceptance before payment.
fields.variation_terms: Record any changes and rates in writing before variation works proceed.
